snippet.title: Bad Cards- Now on DISCORD!
snippet.description:
Bad Cards is now on Discord. The same chaotic, unfiltered party game you love, now just one click away from playing with your friends (or random strangers who might regret joining).

Jump into absurd prompts, create your own custom cards, and see who can make the most unhinged combos. Perfect for game nights, procrastination, or questionable bonding experiences.

🎮 Play Bad Cards on Discord: [Insert your Discord activity link]
🌐 Play the full game online: https://www.bad.cards
📢 Join our community: [Discord server invite link]

Like, subscribe, and prepare to question your life choices.
